edits.new: The harness asserts these rules and changes none of them; the rules themselves are evaluated in RWB-S8-E7005-APP and the states are held by P3 rwb-case. Reference data is read through the reference-data contract under DP-06 and DP-07, and no parameter value is hard-coded; the rule package in force is the parameter set the run reads. The claim deadline, the service level and the Legal route of R-DEV-05 are versioned reference rows held as placeholders until a source gives their values. Both X5 slices trace to FEAT-DVF-05 until the Epic 3 to 8 PRD adds identifiers. Case record U is declared on both operations and the widening of RW-LEGAL is left to rwb-access. The two catalogue events are published through the platform outbox, and step D1 decides whether RWB-PLT-TE006-CON and a rwb-case contract story become dependencies of this key.
